clips.title: The story
paras: The Dust Plains form the dry, wind-scoured southern frontier of Westfall. Marked by arid ground and scarce scrub, the region is overrun by aggressive gnoll encampments and borders an old wizard's tower along its eastern rise.

Stretching across southern Westfall, the Dust Plains mark the transition from troubled farmland to desolate wilderness. Unlike the plundered farmsteads to the north, this arid reach has long been surrendered to packs of feral gnolls who ambush travelers and challenge anyone venturing toward the coast or the nearby hills. On the eastern boundary sits Mortwake's Tower, a lonely magical retreat that offers no shelter from the beasts prowling the surrounding wastes.
